metabolic_screening.label: Newborn Metabolic Screening (blood spot)
metabolic_screening.program: Iowa Department of Health and Human Services — Newborn Screening Program
metabolic_screening.opt_out_form_label: Refusal of Iowa Newborn Blood Spot Screening
metabolic_screening.state_form_system: Iowa HHS form — Refusal of Iowa Newborn Blood Spot Screening. Parents must sign the refusal form; it must be documented in the infant's medical record. Iowa Administrative Code 4.3(2)(b) — waiver/refusal of screening must be documented.
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Collect blood spot per protocol; if parent refuses, ensure signed Refusal of Iowa Newborn Blood Spot Screening form is in the infant's medical record and submitted to IHHS.
metabolic_screening.declination_law: Iowa Admin. Code 4.3(2)(b) — waiver/refusal of screening; refusal documented in infant's medical record; parent/guardian signs refusal of screening waiver.

hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening
hearing_screening.program: Iowa Department of Health and Human Services — EHDI Program
hearing_screening.opt_out_form_label: Refusal of Iowa Newborn Blood Spot Screening (covers hearing component)
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Same refusal form covers hearing screening refusal. Iowa's newborn screening program includes blood spot, hearing, and CCHD screening.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Educate parents; if objection, ensure signed refusal form is in medical record.

cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening
cchd_screening.program: Iowa Department of Health and Human Services — Newborn Screening Program
cchd_screening.opt_out_form_label: Refusal of Iowa Newborn Blood Spot Screening (covers CCHD component)
cchd_screening.state_form_note: Same refusal form covers CCHD screening refusal.
cchd_screening.midwife_role: Perform or refer for pulse ox; if objection, ensure signed refusal form is in medical record.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.program: Iowa law — not part of the NBS program
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: No standalone state declination form for eye prophylaxis; documented via medical record refusal.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.midwife_role: If declining: document refusal in medical record. If administering: apply within 1h of birth.

vitamin_k.label: Vitamin K (oral or injection)
vitamin_k.midwife_role: Three-way informed choice (oral / shot / none) documented in medical record; midwife administers injection if chosen.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine (birth dose)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.program: Iowa Department of Health and Human Services — Immunization Program
hepatitis_b_vaccine.midwife_role: Birth-dose consent or declination documented in writing; report to Iowa Immunization Registry (IIR).

gestational_diabetes.label: Gestational Diabetes Screening (prenatal)
gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice; midwife refers out for glucose testing when declined.

group_b_strep.label: Group B Strep Screening & Prophylaxis (prenatal)
group_b_strep.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice per ACOG/CDC; swab testing via referral or in-office; intrapartum antibiotics referred if opted-in.
